visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female presenter with light brown hair and round glasses wears a beige turtleneck and holds a small black microphone. She is in a brightly lit office with framed certificates on the wall. Animated icons of a doctor and a seated patient appear in front of her. (2) A graphic icon of two women talking replaces the previous icon while the presenter continues speaking with an expressive facial expression. (3) The screen displays a close-up image of a person's hand with visible aging spots. The presenter appears in a small circular inset at the bottom right, pointing toward the spots. (4) The presenter returns to full frame, gesturing with both hands. A large red 'X' icon and the text '絕對是錯的' appear over the center of the frame. (5) A split-screen graphic shows two different hands with significant skin wrinkling and sun damage. The presenter's hands are visible as she gestures in the foreground. (6) Images of orange sunscreen bottles appear behind the presenter. (7) Close-up footage shows a person applying facial cream and another person massaging moisturizer into their hands, focusing on the texture and application movement. (8) A series of green checkmarks and text blocks listing skincare ingredients (A-acid, Vitamin C) appear sequentially beside the presenter. (9) Short clips show medical laser treatments being performed on skin, with red aiming beams and the laser device tip moving across the surface. (10) A white background with gray brushstrokes displays the clinic's logo and detailed contact information, including a phone number and addresses.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 female presenter as the main character; footage shows hands of 2 different patients and face of 1 patient undergoing laser treatment.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A professional female presenter wearing a beige turtleneck and glasses, holding a RODE wireless microphone.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The primary background is a clean, professional office with medical degrees and certificates. Secondary backgrounds include close-up shots of skin and product photography of sunscreen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The female narrator begins speaking in a high-clarity, professional yet friendly voice. The background music is an upbeat acoustic guitar track with a light piano melody and consistent percussion. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect coincides with the visual appearance of the animated doctor icon. The narrator's speech rate is steady and enthusiastic. (3) A digital pop sound occurs as the aging hand image is shown. The BGM remains consistent in volume behind the vocals. (4) A comic 'boing' or 'ding' sound accompanies the appearance of the red 'X' graphic. The narrator's pitch rises to emphasize that hand sun exposure is often ignored. (5) Rapid succession of soft 'pop' sound effects play as checkmarks appear on the screen list. (6) A subtle technical humming sound is barely audible under the narration during the laser treatment footage. (7) The BGM swells slightly in volume as the narrator concludes and the clinic contact information is displayed, ending with a clean fade out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on the cumulative damage caused by UV rays on hands and to promote the dermatological and aesthetic services of DRX Dermatology Clinic. It emphasizes that hand skincare should be as meticulous as facial care and showcases professional medical laser solutions for aging spots.
